information.description:
A giant meets an equally sized gun, and they make sweet love inside of a superheavy suit of armor. Give them milspec cybernetics, ex-Militech spec ops training, plus a suitably hefty ego, and you make one hell of a threat for anything other than a tank. Gunners are some of the toughest foes anyone in Night City could encounter, and should be treated with the appropriate amount of respect, or else become a stain under their steel-toed boots.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Barghest).

description.value: Experts in combat who use their fighting prowess to dominate in the lawless time of the Red.
Throwing hands, does not ignore half armor.

The Mk. 31 HMG was engineered with two functions in mind: 1) mounting on armored vehicles, 2) installing on defensive perimeters. In other words, it was meant as a bolted-down heavy-hitter. No one inside Militech ever considered anyone could or would want to carry this massive gun anywhere whether they were loaded with cyberware or not. But, as usual, it seems the human will found a way. The Mk. 31 HMG can sometimes be found cradled in the arms of heavily chromed solos and gangoons, as they're the only people capable of withstanding its recoil. However, the Mk. 31 cannot be reloaded easily in combat situations, effectively making it a one-hit wonder. Still, by the time this beast’s clip is emptied, there's typically no one left to shoot at anyway.

NOTE: Credit to Infernox_Ratchet for the basis and initial creation of this item.

Before Myers declared war, Militech engineers were asked: How can you equip grunts with superheavy armor and weapons without a full ACPA while avoiding cyberpsychosis? Ultimately, they stripped a Linear Frame to its core components and dedicated all hydraulic power to the legs and hips. These ‘Wolfpack’ frames were highly praised during the war, especially by Militech special forces. Nowadays though, the Wolfpack lets BARGHEST lug around giant guns to mow down gangers with.

The Wolfpack Linear Frame can only be bought as an External Frame. For installation as an External Frame, two installations of Interface Plugs are required. While connected properly to the frame, the total REF and MOVE penalty applied to the user (if any) from worn armor and wielded weapons is reduced by 2, or by 1 for any form of MetalGear (Minimum 0). This frame cannot increase the user's BODY in any way, nor modify their HP or Death Save.

Foundry notes:

  • While connected, your total REF and MOVE penalty from worn armor and wielded weapons drops by 2, or by 1 for any Metalgear (minimum 0); apply by hand.
